batting.name: C Madan
batting.dismissal: c A Mishra b AB McDonald

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b A Nehra

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c AG Murtaza b CRD Fernando

balls.text: that's what big hitters do to you. It's just not coming out right. Surely he tries another yorker, and again it turns out to be a full toss and he clears the front leg and goes square for another six
finally he gets the yorker right, and still Warner has to dive at long-on to save the boundary
poor bowling here, short, and Pollard lofts it over midwicket. The big man has arrived
short ball, and muscled down the ground, the long-off could move only four steps by the time it cannoned into the boundary board

the yorker goes wrong by a little, and Pollard makes it horribly wrong! Low full toss, and Pollard has hit it over midwicket and out of CCI. For a moment, one of those floodlight towers looked prone too
starts with a low full toss, gets a single to deep point
another swinging yorker, another single, good over except for that manufactured six
naturally the length shortens, but Pollard can't get it past midwicket
that's one way of undoing yorkers! The ramp! The big man can be delicate too. Stays back, gets on a knee, takes it on the full, and scoops it over the keeper's head for, yes, six
misses the yorker by a few inches, but JP gets only a single, to deep midwicket
full and straight again, another single
yorker, spot on, just a single
quicker ball, Pollard stays in the crease and can't get it off the square
it's a mis-hit for a six! What power, what a small ground! Toe-ends it over long-off
floated across JP, cut to deep point for one
another leading edge, this time to short third man
and Karthik lets another one through, Ladda has beaten Pollard twice in two balls. This time he looks for the big straight shot, gets a thick edge that goes past Karthik. Difficult chance, but a drop
and he gets a leading edge first ball, Pollard looks to turn it to leg, and ends up hitting into the off side, along the ground, for two
too much premeditation, Nehra bounces him as he sees him charge down, and Rayudu holes out to long-on
wastes a leg-stump full toss by hitting it one-bounce to deep fine leg
slower ball, nicely bowled, clearly early into the slog, but it misses the leg stump
goes for the yorker, slides it down the leg side
fuller, angled down to third man for one
length ball, and he murders it wide of long-off, solid power behind that
clipped away off the middle stump, over square leg, but won't go to the boundary
and Duminy rubs it in by coming down the track again, taking this one on the full, and almost pushing it past long-off. Lovely timing
the googly, almost does him in as he jumps out of the track, but the outside edge is healthy enough to go past Kathik
loose ball, full on the pads, and easily swept past short fine
goes for the stumping down the leg side again, and Rayudu manages to get an inside edge onto the pad
worked away wide of deep midwicket for two
JP gives him the charge and pushes him down to long-on
end of a good PC spell, finishes off with an accurate offcutter that yields a single to point
looks for the slog, gets the inside half of the bat for just one
good play all around! Sees Rayudu coming, fires it down the leg side, and Rayudu makes sure he gets his back foot across and doesn't let the ball go through to Karthik
gives him the charge, gets too close to it, and hits it straight to extra cover
full ball, driven down to long-off for one
dropped by Karthik, Rayudu looks to drive an offbreak, gets a thick edge that hits Karthik on the thumb and pops out
is welcome by the bouncer, which he ducks under
slower ball, perfect line, pitching just outside off and breaking away to hit the stumps. Tiwary aborts the big shot, looks to open the face but misses
length ball outside off, and again he gives this hit his all, and whilst he has mis-hit he is looking to go over extra and hence is safe
slower short one now, pulled wide of deep midwicket for two
that's a Tiwary special, walks down the pitch and wallops this bouncer over midwicket. Don't bother with the niceties, this is a proper muscled wallop
length ball outside off, Tiwary's eye light up, gives it the full swing, but down the wrong line
slower offcutter, bunted to cover for one
length ball, pushed down to long-on for one
looks to make room, holds his ground later, Collingwood bowls straight, and he gets a single to short fine
Collingwood has been running in but bowling like a spinner, so Tiwary now treats him like one. Picks the slower one early and slog-sweeps him over midwicket
slower, loopy offbreak, mis-hit over Collingwood's head for one
offcutter outside off, run down to short third for a single
short ball, pushed to long-on for one
short ball, pulled to deep square leg
slower ball, pushed with soft hands wide of long-on and they hustle through for another couple
offcutter again, not drivebale, and pushed to point for one
slower ball, worked away to square leg for one
first boundary in 28 balls! and what a lovely shot, lofted on the up, high elbow and all, and straight of long-on
good running, pushed slightly wide of long-on and they rush back for two
slower ball, around leg stump, hit back to the bowler
makes room to cut, Collingwood follows with the angle, and he hits it straight to point
full offbreak, dragged from outside off to long-on for one
drops and runs, not too far from Karthik, just makes it in time
full offbreak, hit down to long-on for one
fuller delivery, squeezed past point for one
back of a length, around off, pushed to short cover
Good afternoon Mr Rayudu! bouncer to begin with, sharp too, has to be quick in swaying out of the way

but he gets SRT the easy way! Soft dismissal on the face of it, but there hasn;t been a boundary for three has been only one boundary since ball No. 4.1. Makes room to hit a length ball inside-out, doesn't get the elevation and hits straight down straightish extra cover's lap. Silence at the CCI

they'll do anything for SRT wicket! Sangwan appeals for a run-out as a straight hit from Tiwary hits the non-striker's stumps. But it is inches away from Sangwan's hand, the umpire knows it, and Sangwan smiles sheepishly. Naughty
length ball, driven on the up, one bounce to extra cover
clever shot, a paddle from outside off, with the spin, but he finds short fine leg
overpitched, pushed to long-off for one
another offspinner, short and pulled away for one
slower offbreak, bunted into the on side, where no man is in the circle, and takes an easy single
and again, he places it between deep square and deep midwicket to come back for an easy two
played with the angle, soft hands ensure a couple
one hand comes off the bat as he squeezes this past cover for one
back of a length, no room, pushed to cover
slower offcutter, looks to paddle it, gets a single off an inside edge onto the pad
beaten for length as he looks to run it past short third, it's just too full for that shot
same length, slightly wider, punched away to deep point
nice offcutter, back of a length, Tiwary looks to run it down but is beaten
quicker one pushed down to long-off for one
pitched on the pads again, and this time it is hit too hard, so only one
smart batting, flighted on the pads, and he just meets it with an angled bat and soft hands, and rushes back for two
nice shot, too full on the pads, and swept away square of short fine, and fine of deep square
nicely flighted, nearly yorks him, bunted to cover for one
swept away fine for a single
late-cut, nicely done, gets a single to third man
punched and Viru is done in by the bad bounce at straight extra cover this time
Viru is livid as he misfields this one at straight midwicket and lets through a single
finally Madan edges to hand, slower short ball, and he pulls off the front foot and Mishra takes a smart catch running back from short fine and getting right under it
stays back to pull this to deep square
pushes a length ball straight to cover
stays back to powerfully cut a fullish one, but straight to cover-point
the quicker front-of-the-hand-one, yorks him
Madan jumps out of the crease and is beaten by the googly, which hits him in the pad and rolls off
another shot wide of mid-on, not much power in it, and with single SRT overtakes Kallis as the leading scorer in this IPL
stays back this time to turn it to leg, but hits it straight to square leg
beautiful shot, comes down the track, gets too close to it, but still gets power into that shot, all timing actually, and hits it all along the ground and wide of mid-on for four
another flick shot, but this time closer to deep square leg
"walking flick", says Sunny G on air, and it is one, as he walks down the wicket and flicks it from outside off, against the angle, and wide of deep square
what a reply, perfect yorker, even SRT can't do much with it

slower bouncer, over the stumps, and the umpire has inexplicably called it a wide. Harper from square leg is signalling it went nose-high, but the main umpire has called it wide. Line was good, so was height! Ordinary umpiring
back of a length, pushed to mid-off for one, what's more, he has over-stepped
bouncer, but too short and too high
short of driving length, pushed to cover
full and swinging in again, clipped away fine , in the air, and just fine of short fine, Nehra
full, swinging in, but down the leg side
worked away off the pads for a single to deep square leg
slower ball, slightly short of a length, defended back to the bowler
fuller ball, that's Madan's striking zone, and he smashes it back at Nehra who fields in his follow through
that is downright unfair! the fast bowler balls a peach of a bouncer, catching the batsman slow, and hits him in the helmet, and the batting side still gets four runs via leg-byes
clipped away off the pads for a single
fuller, and this time Madan opens the bat to get a single
short ball into the ribs, 134.3, tucks him up
sharp bouncer, beats him for the pace as he tries to pull, Karthik appeals for a catch but nobody else is interested
slower ball, runs it down to third man for a single
back of a length, turned around the corner for the first run as intended - other 14 have been edges and misfields
full ball around off, and pushed to mid-on
Mumbai have well and truly edged ahead in this contest, this time Sachin inside-edges Sangwan, and it's placed painfully perfectly, past the keeper
back of a length, pushed towards Warner at midwicket, and his eagerness and the consequent misfield costs them two
swing in to him again, this time he is behind the line of it and defends
back of a length, Madan stays back and defends
Nehra unfortunate again, bowls the one angling away, has the desired result, an outside/toe edge, but it goes wide of first slip for four
gets the middle of the bat this time, hits a full ball towards mid-off
more swing, appeal for lbw, a slight inside edge makes it slide down the leg side
swing right up, sharp swing, and Madan gets a perfect inside edge to beat keeper and fine leg
hit straight of long-on for two
clears the front leg and hits it to long-on for two
swipes across the line and misses
slower ball, gets a single off the inside edge
hit along the ground to long-off this time
Finally a boundary! Timed well and straight over the bowler's head
full toss, gets it over midwicket, still doesn't get a boundary. The last boundary came off the fourth ball of the sixth over
full toss again, hit for one
goes for the big heave, gets a single off the back of the bat
yorker, squeezed out for a single
full toss on the pads, hit to square leg for one
pushed down to long-on for one
worked into the on side for one
beaten by the offbreak this time as he looks to sweep
beaten by the straighter one as he goes for heave
cut away wide of deep point
flicked off the leg stump for a single
cut away from leg stump for one
bowled him! They say aim for the top of off stump, and Fernando does just that. Only he doesn't pitch it, a full toss taking out top of off as Mishra swings inside the line
hit powerfully down to long-off for one
back of a length, gets a single to point
this time the split-finger one comes out right, hit down to long-on for one
beamer! down the leg side too, slips out
runs this down to third man
helped away to fine leg for one
topspinner, stays back and defends
comes down the track and hits it to long-off
pulled to deep midwicket for one
played from outside off, for one to square leg
another single to short fine
turned around the corner for one
played with an open face to deep point for one
back of a length, flicked away for one
stays his ground and swings, and is beaten again
beats him with a slower one as he is early into the charge and wings
worked away to deep midwicket for a single
short, pulled away to deep square for a single
end of a superb spell, with a single to long-off
another single to extra cover
played to extra cover for a single
arm ball, plays this one well, but only for a single to long-off
comes down the track to hit this one to long-off
full ball, hit to sweeper-cover for one
slower ball, hit back to the bowler
worked to short fine for one
slower short one, cut over the infield for one
opens the face to point
worked away to deep square leg for one
more confusion with the running, hit straight to point, and McDonald has to send back Mishra
timber! All over for DK. All over for DD, I daresay. Arm ball again, Karthik, much like de Villiers, stays back to a fullish one, and his bat is late in coming down as it skids off the surface
gets this one past a diving extra cover for a single
looks to play inside-out, there is no spin on this one, and he ends up hitting it back to the bowler
pulled to deep midwicket for a single
pushed to cover for one
short ball, and pulled to deep midwicket
gets a short ball, which he stays away from

Delhi are running like headless chickens! Collingwood is beaten as he looks to turn this to leg, the ball hits the pads and goes nowhere, but he wants a single, and Karthik does him no favours by haring down the wicket. Karthik recovers in time, but it is too late for Collingwood. And boy, does Pollard respond, keeps running in his follow through, fields it and underarm-flicks the stumps
length ball outside off, defended back to the bowler
back of a length, worked away to deep square for a single
slower ball, helped way past short third for one
charges at him and turns him to deep midwicket for one
some turn, it stops at him too, checks his shot towards extra cover
short ball, pulled to deep midwicket for one
steps out first ball, gets a soft leading edge for a single
plumb! arm ball! AB stays back to a fullish one, and is reading it off the pitch, and he is caught dead in front
bunted into the leg side for one
fired into the pads, gets two leg-byes, fine of short fine leg
pushed to sweeper-cover for one
another slower ball, gets an inside edge into the leg side
walks out, moves across, hits a slower ball back to Pollard
fuller ball, hit straight to extra cover
angled into the pads, helped away for a single
starts with a slow ball, dropped to on side for a single
bunted towards midwicket for a single
full ball, turned into the leg side for one
hit down to long-on for one

Delhi's trouble with run-outs continues! It is Sehwag once again going for a non-existent second. How many times have we seen Sehwag and Gambhir get too optimistic with their running? Hit slightly wide of Pollard at long-on, and he takes the arm on, and Pollard fires in a bullet adjacent to the stumps, and there is no desperate dive either to save himself
short, quick, hit to the right of Murtaza who makes a good diving save
full ball, hit wide of long-on, thinks about two but Bravo is too quick running in from deep midwicket
shorter ball, this time it has been played to right of Zak at short third, and they come through for one
looks to open his face after stretching wide to get to this ball, hits straight to short third

Bhajji strikes! Gambhir, who generally creates length when facing spinners, gets too clever here. Shows Bhajji he is coming down, then rocks back, expecting a short ball, but Bhaj keeps his length and Gambhir gets a leading edge as he looks to turn this to leg. Easy return catch and Bhajji is pumped, kicks the ball away
turning in, bunted away for one
he stays back and pulls this one to deep midwicket for one
turning into the pads, helped around the corner
slower ball, Sehwag stays back to turn it to deep midwicket for one
short and wide down the leg side
manufactures a leg-stump line this time by moving across, but this flick goes straight to short fine
this the rub-the-salt-in shot, Bravo strays on the pads, and this time he guides it to the other side of short fine

Pollard almost pulls off a stunner. Another slower ball nearly takes a wicket. This time Gambhir manages a high one between mid-on and long-on, Pollard runs back, and dives to get his hands to it, but can't control it
good shot, goooood shot, on the pads, and nicely guided past short fine. No need of power here
starts with a length ball, hit down to long-on
and it's Gambhir's turn now, gives the charge, hits a length ball wide of mid-on, gets four

lovely play, sees Sehwag charge down, fires it down the leg side looking for a stumping, but Sehwag shuffles to kick it away, and he takes a leg-bye, and the umpires allow the leg-bye. He wasn't attempting a shot surely
comes down the track, gets this on the full, hits it powerfully to the left of Bhaj, and good thing he didn't get a hand to it - it would have burst through it, I kid you not
stays back, and runs this down to short third
takes half a step down and defends
hit on the bounce to deep midwicket for one

that split-fingered slower one nearly consumed two of the most dangerous batsmen in the world in three deliveries! This time Sehwag ends up skying it, and Murtaza from mid-on gets under a much simpler catch than the previous one, but the ball slips through the reverse-cup
short and wide, cut over cover-point

split-finger slower ball, you beauty! Once again Warner is late in reading this one, and decides to over mid-off, but the toe-end only ends up looping to nowhere, and Murtaza takes a smart catch running back from mid-off
again clears his front leg early, sees a length ball around off, and decides to go over covers
length ball, quicker one, driven straight, but to extra cover

another slower ball from Fenrando, he is good with those ones, but Warner's response is same, clear front leg, and decide which shot to play. This time he goes for the slog-sweep, and although he doesn't connect, this skier is safe and wide enough of long-on
another near-yorker, Warner clears his front leg and hits it down to long-on for one
and Sehwag misses another leg-side offering, gets inside the line but this one doesn't get up as much as he expects, but will steal a leg-bye
full, nearly a yorker, squeezed out for a single
and dishes up a half-volley, and Warner hits him straight into the sight screen. Lovely straight strike
length balls are definitely not gonna work with this man, crashes this one past mid-on, too fast, too strong
goes for the short ball into the body, Warner is waiting for it and pulls him over short fine. That's a message against the short-pitched bowling
split-finger slower ball, Sehwag is early into the shot, hit uppishly towards mid-on, and it falls just short of Ali Murtaza at mid-on. The third umpire confirms it is a half-volley
shot! looks for the yorker, it ends up being about a foot shorter of being one, and Sehwag goes deep in the crease and punches it past mid-on
misses out on a leg-side length ball, 134kph, late into it
full, nearly a yorker, outside off, steered away to third man for one
full and down the pads, Sehwag misses out really, gets just a leg-bye, that too thanks to Madan's fumble
length ball, straight, hit to cover, off the outside half of the bat
looks to clip it off the pads, gets an inside edge onto the pad that goes fine past Tendulkar in orange cap
full ball, gets the inside half of the bat as he drives
lovely shot! back of a length, no room, but he punches it, awesome timing, wide of mid-off, and the fast outfield does the rest
Pollard misfields on the practice wicket around the cover-point area, Sehwag gets a single
similar delivery, looks to clip it, gets a leg-bye for one
short, into the ribs, tucks him up
